name: GitLab
description: Trigger workflows from GitLab issues, merge requests and pipeline results, and create or comment on issues and merge requests from a step.

triggers.label: An issue is created
triggers.description: Fires once for each issue created in the project since the last poll.

env.name: GITLAB_BASE_URL
env.description: Instance URL without a trailing slash. Leave the default for gitlab.com.
env.builderHint: Every request goes to <baseUrl>/api/v4. A self-managed instance under a relative root (https://host/gitlab) works as-is. Declared requests append the path verbatim, so a trailing slash here would double it.

env.name: GITLAB_PROJECT
env.description: Path such as group/project, or the numeric id. The triggers poll this project.
env.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded (group%2Fproject) as the :id segment, as the docs require for namespaced paths. Actions take their own project input so one connection can act on several.

env.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
env.description: Leave empty to borrow the glab CLI login. Needs scope api, or read_api for the triggers and read-only actions.
env.builderHint: Created under Edit profile, Access, Personal access tokens, Generate token; prefixed glpat-, 365-day default expiry. Filled, it is sent as-is and glab is never run; empty, the connector asks glab config get token --host <host>.

env.name: GITLAB_REF
env.description: Branch or tag whose pipelines to watch. Blank for every ref.
env.builderHint: Sent as the ref filter on GET /projects/:id/pipelines; the other two triggers ignore it.

triggers.label: A merge request is opened
triggers.description: Fires once for each merge request opened in the project since the last poll.

actions.label: Create an issue
actions.description: Open a new issue in a project.

inputs.label: Project
inputs.description: Project path such as group/project, or its numeric id
inputs.builderHint: The path is what the URL shows after the host; the id is on the project page. Either is sent URL-encoded as the :id segment.

inputs.label: Labels
inputs.builderHint: GitLab takes labels as one comma-separated string, so this is passed through as typed.

outputs.description: The number shown in the project, as in #12

actions.label: Comment on an issue
actions.description: Post a note on an issue.

inputs.label: Project
inputs.description: Project path such as group/project, or its numeric id
inputs.builderHint: The path is what the URL shows after the host; the id is on the project page. Either is sent URL-encoded as the :id segment.

inputs.label: Issue number
inputs.description: The issue number shown in the project (its iid, not the global id)

inputs.label: Internal note
inputs.description: Visible to project members only. Defaults to false.
inputs.builderHint: The documented replacement for the deprecated confidential flag on notes.

outputs.description: Who posted it, as {id, username, name}
The iid it was posted on
Whether only members can see it

inputs.label: Project

inputs.label: Merge request number
inputs.description: The merge request number shown in the project (its iid)

inputs.label: Internal note

actions.label: Get a project
actions.description: Read a project by path or id.

inputs.label: Project
inputs.description: Project path such as group/project, or its numeric id
inputs.builderHint: The path is what the URL shows after the host; the id is on the project page. Either is sent URL-encoded as the :id segment.

outputs.description: The last segment of the path
When something last happened in it
The owning group or user, as {id, name, path, fullPath, kind}

actions.label: List open merge requests
actions.description: The open merge requests of a project, most recently updated first.

inputs.label: Project
inputs.description: Project path such as group/project, or its numeric id
inputs.builderHint: The path is what the URL shows after the host; the id is on the project page. Either is sent URL-encoded as the :id segment.

inputs.label: Maximum
inputs.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as per_page; 100 is the documented maximum.

inputs.label: Target branch
inputs.description: Only merge requests into this branch. Blank for all.

outputs.description: How many merge requests came back

One entry per merge request, shaped as the merge request trigger delivers it: externalId (the iid), title, url, description, status, labels, updatedAt, and data with id, iid, projectId, sourceBranch, targetBranch, draft, sha, author, createdAt, changedAt, mergedAt, closedAt, hasConflicts, detailedMergeStatus

actions.label: Get an issue
actions.description: Read one issue by its number.

inputs.label: Project
inputs.description: Project path such as group/project, or its numeric id
inputs.builderHint: The path is what the URL shows after the host; the id is on the project page. Either is sent URL-encoded as the :id segment.

inputs.label: Issue number
inputs.description: The issue number shown in the project (its iid)

outputs.description: The number shown in the project
Who opened it, as {id, username, name}
When it was closed, or null
Whether only members can see it
